name: acad-xrefs
description: Attach, manage, clip and bind external references (XREFs): the mechanism every multi-file project is built on. Covers attach/overlay, reload/unload, bind and insert-bind, path repair, rectangular/polygonal/object clipping, nested xref inspection and per-xref layer overrides.
intent_examples: what layers does this xref bring
what xrefs are in this drawing
which xrefs come from other xrefs

tools_summary.name: attach_xref
tools_summary.description: Attach an external drawing as an XREF (attachment). Attachments are carried into any drawing that in turn references this one - use attach_xref_overlay when you do not want that. Block name defaults to the file name; insertion, scale and rotation default to origin/1/0.

tools_summary.name: attach_xref_overlay
tools_summary.description: Attach an external drawing as an OVERLAY. Overlays are NOT carried through when this drawing is itself referenced elsewhere, which is what stops circular and duplicated references in a multi-discipline set. Prefer this for cross-discipline backgrounds.

tools_summary.name: bind_xref
tools_summary.description: Bind an XREF into this drawing, making it a permanent local block. Default (bind mode) renames dependent symbols to blockName$0$LAYER; insertMode=true merges them into existing local symbols instead, which is usually what you want for issue-ready files but can collide with local names.

tools_summary.name: clip_xref_polygonal
tools_summary.description: Clip one XREF insert to an arbitrary closed polygon given as an ordered vertex list in WCS. Needs at least 3 vertices; the polygon is closed automatically.

tools_summary.name: clip_xref_rect
tools_summary.description: Clip one XREF insert to a rectangle given by two opposite corners in WCS. inverted=true hides what is inside the rectangle instead of outside. Clipping is per-insert, so pass a handle from get_xref_info, not a block name.

tools_summary.name: delete_xref_clip
tools_summary.description: Remove the clip boundary from an XREF insert so the whole reference displays again. Succeeds quietly when there was no clip.

tools_summary.name: detach_xref
tools_summary.description: Detach an XREF completely: removes the definition and every insert of it. Fails if the xref is nested under another reference - detach the parent instead.

tools_summary.name: find_missing_xrefs
tools_summary.description: List every XREF whose file cannot be resolved at its saved path. Read-only; pair with set_xref_path or repath_all_xrefs to fix them.

tools_summary.name: get_xref_info
tools_summary.description: Full descriptor of one XREF by block name, plus the handles of every BlockReference insert of it. Use the returned handles for clipping, which is per-insert.

tools_summary.name: invert_xref_clip
tools_summary.description: Flip an existing clip boundary inside-out: what was hidden becomes visible and the reverse. Errors if the insert has no clip.

tools_summary.name: list_nested_xrefs
tools_summary.description: List XREFs that are referenced by another XREF rather than directly by this drawing, with their parent. Nested references cannot be detached or repathed here - do that in the parent drawing.

tools_summary.name: list_xref_dependent_symbols
tools_summary.description: List the layers, linetypes, text styles, dimension styles and blocks that arrive in this drawing through one XREF. These are the names that get renamed on bind - check here before binding to predict collisions.

tools_summary.name: list_xrefs
tools_summary.description: List every XREF in the drawing with its path, resolution status, overlay/attachment kind, nesting and insert count. Read-only. This is the tool to call first when a drawing does not look right.

tools_summary.name: reload_all_xrefs
tools_summary.description: Reload every resolved XREF in the drawing. Reports per-xref status so partial failures are visible.

tools_summary.name: reload_xref
tools_summary.description: Reload one XREF from disk, picking up changes another author has saved. Returns the resolved status so a failure to find the file is visible rather than silent.

tools_summary.name: repath_all_xrefs
tools_summary.description: Bulk path repair: replace oldPrefix with newPrefix in every XREF path. dryRun=true reports what would change, including whether each new path actually resolves, without writing anything. Run the dry run first.

tools_summary.name: reset_xref_layer_overrides
tools_summary.description: Drop layer overrides for one XREF, returning its layers to the properties defined in the source drawing. Pass a layer name to reset just that one, or omit it to reset all of them.

tools_summary.name: set_xref_clip_display
tools_summary.description: Show or hide the clip boundary frame itself, without changing what the clip hides. Frames are useful while laying out and wrong on an issued sheet.

tools_summary.name: set_xref_layer_override
tools_summary.description: Override colour, linetype, lineweight, on/off or frozen state for one layer coming from an XREF, without touching the source drawing. This is how a background reference is greyed back on a plan.

tools_summary.name: set_xref_path
tools_summary.description: Point one XREF at a different file. relativePath=true stores it relative to this drawing, which is what survives moving the project folder. Reloads by default so the result is immediately verifiable.

tools_summary.name: unload_xref
tools_summary.description: Unload an XREF: its geometry stops displaying and stops loading, but the definition and inserts stay so it can be reloaded later. Use this rather than detach for temporarily hiding a heavy reference.
